north_star: Preserve project meaning, analytical reasoning, provenance, decisions, requirements, task priority, verification and continuation state in a portable form that remains usable independently of any single chat, tool, repository or execution provider.

record_meanings.statement: Near-literal or faithful capture of material user/project input.
record_meanings.question: An unresolved or answered question that matters to project continuation.
record_meanings.analysis: Reasoning that explains, interprets, compares or evaluates project facts.
record_meanings.finding: A supported observation or defect/problem statement.
record_meanings.solution: A proposed remedy or design response, distinct from a decision.
record_meanings.decision: An attributable selection, rejection, deferral or supersession of a course of action.
record_meanings.requirement: A condition the system/project must satisfy.
record_meanings.task: Executable work derived from approved/authorized project knowledge.
record_meanings.evidence: Observed or source-bound support for project knowledge.
record_meanings.verification: An observed check/result; does not equal acceptance.
record_meanings.acceptance: Authorized acceptance by an appropriate owner/user/role.

canonical_levels.P0: Critical — security, data-integrity, catastrophic reliability or system-blocking work that may preempt the normal queue.
canonical_levels.P1: High — major functional/reliability work normally scheduled before medium/low work.
canonical_levels.P2: Medium — architecture, maintainability, UX, performance or normal product work unless explicitly escalated.
canonical_levels.P3: Low — cosmetic, formatting, low-impact cleanup or deferrable refinement.
canonical_levels.unassigned: Priority has not been authoritatively assigned; never guess.

invariants.rule: Canonical snapshots and analysis overlays MUST have non-null project_id and artifact_id.
Canonical snapshots MUST preserve owner-confirmed Product Purpose when known; do not infer it solely from source/features/architecture.
Material record_id values MUST be unique within an artifact.
No acknowledged material user intent may remain conversation-only; persist a faithful capture and derived material records with provenance.
Solution is distinct from Analysis, Decision, Requirement, Task, Verification and Acceptance.
A proposed Solution MUST NOT be treated as selected merely because it is newer, AI-generated or experimentally implemented.
An analysis_overlay advances analysis knowledge without claiming a new software release.
If development advances beyond an overlay base, merge overlay knowledge onto the latest valid canonical PE by stable IDs/provenance/conflict checks; never replace newer PE with the old overlay base.
Every new Task MUST carry priority=P0|P1|P2|P3|unassigned. Use unassigned instead of guessing.
Priority is not implementation authorization.
Priority and execution_order are separate. Priority expresses importance/urgency; execution_order expresses queue order within a context.
Dependencies, blockers, safety/data-integrity constraints and explicit owner direction may override queue order; record the reason.
Changing a Task priority is a material change and MUST preserve provenance/change history.
If a project declares a canonical Project Evolution store/channel, participating writers MUST read the latest canonical state before material mutation.
A stale writer MUST NOT overwrite newer canonical PE state; it must fetch, compare/merge and preserve parallel/conflicting material knowledge.
A declared startup_document_ref is the deterministic onboarding entry point and SHOULD explain how to discover current PE state, role, source alignment and open work.

When PE is maintained in commit-based version control, every material PE commit SHOULD state artifact/revision, change type, material summary, affected records, source context, verification and acceptance state.
Verification and Acceptance are distinct; build/test/runtime success MUST NOT imply owner/user acceptance.
Compaction MAY reduce verbosity but MUST preserve material derivation chains needed to recover why important decisions/tasks exist.
Missing historical provenance/priority/purpose MUST remain explicitly unknown/unassigned; never fabricate it.
